item.title: Bikini skiing takes off on slopes as record warmth forces resorts into survival mode
item.summary: Western ski resorts face record warm temperatures and low snowfall, with skiers swapping jackets for bikinis and T-shirts as trails close and dirt replaces snow.

item.title: Trump commandeers Cabinet members to campaign in midterms, ordering them to drop or mute controversial stances
item.summary: Trump is deploying Cabinet members to push popular agenda items and minimize GOP losses in the midterms – but how likely is a massive blue wave in the first place?

item.title: Coach K invokes Bill Belichick's rough UNC debut when asked about Michael Malone's Tar Heels hire
item.summary: Duke legend Mike Krzyzewski isn't worried about UNC reportedly hiring NBA champion coach Michael Malone, citing Bill Belichick's tough transition to college.

item.title: CM Punk torches Pat McAfee after he's inserted into major WWE feud, demands WrestleMania ticket prices lowered
item.summary: CM Punk fired back at ESPN broadcaster Pat McAfee on "Monday Night Raw," slamming his involvement in a major WrestleMania 42 feud with Cody Rhodes.

item.title: Economist editor says European leaders now fear a true NATO 'divorce' after Trump pullout threat
item.summary: Trump is reportedly considering pulling the U.S. out of NATO, and European leaders are coming to terms with what may be a true divorce, says an editor.

item.title: Influencer Jake Paul says Charlie Kirk would have been 'the next president'
item.summary: Jake Paul says Charlie Kirk would have eventually become president if he were not assassinated, while noting his own political ambitions after receiving Trump's endorsement.

item.title: ABC News had a 75-person division dedicated to 'get' Trump, Billy Bush claims
item.summary: On the "Hang Out with Sean Hannity" podcast," former TV host Billy Bush alleged ABC News had a 75-person division dedicated to "get" Donald Trump during the 2016 election.

item.title: New poll reveals Spanberger's popularity is plummeting amid backlash over gerrymandering
item.summary: Gov. Abigail Spanberger battles record unpopularity in Virginia with 46% disapproval, the lowest rating for a governor since 1994, a new poll is showing.

item.title: Mamdani unveils new 'racial equity plan' for more 'equitable future' that prompts quick DOJ pushback
item.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani releases New York City's first citywide racial equity plan, prompting conservative pushback and a DOJ review of the new initiative.

item.title: CBS to replace Colbert’s ‘Late Show’ with Byron Allen’s ‘Comics Unleashed’
item.summary: CBS is replacing Stephen Colbert's canceled "Late Show" with Byron Allen's "Comics Unleashed" in a historic late night shakeup beginning May 2026.
